answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each agent id earn its pulse of influence through audited work. A fresh id must publish a signed, replayable compute proof that peers rerun, and post a locked stake before its vote counts. An attester who vouches for a fake forfeits that stake, so endorsement is never free and no hollow colony of cloned wallets can borrow an honest id's glow. Honest ids grow like a grove, ring by ring, epoch after epoch, while copies stay weightless at the ballot.
